visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and straight bangs, wearing a fluffy brown sweater, sits in a well-lit room. Behind her is a white shelf holding books, decorative glass jars, and small figurines. She holds up several Maybelline lip glaze boxes, smiling broadly and gesturing with her hands while a bright red lip color is visible on her face. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman's forearm, displaying six vertical swatches of various lipstick shades ranging from warm orange to deep berry. Text overlays identify each specific color number and name. The lighting is even and bright studio lighting, highlighting the glossy texture and pigment of the swatches against her fair skin. (3) Several close-up shots show the woman's mouth as she applies the lip glaze using a sponge-tip applicator. She moves her lips together to spread the product, then poses with a finger to her lip, showcasing the shimmering effect indicated by animated floating variety text. (4) A fast-paced montage depicts the woman drinking from a straw, kissing a clear glass to demonstrate no transfer, eating a meal from a red bowl with chopsticks, and kissing a tabby cat. The setting shifts to a living room with a white couch. She finishes by wiping her lips with a white cotton pad, showing that it remains clean and residue-free.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark hair, straight bangs, wearing a brown textured fuzzy sweater and fair makeup with bright red lipstick.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A room with a white shelf containing books (including 'Cats'), decorative jars, and a chess set. Later shifts to a living room with a white couch and home decor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience in Traditional Chinese. Fast speech rate with high pitch variability. Upbeat electronic pop music with a driving synthetic bass and crisp percussion starts immediately. Ambient floor is studio-clean silence. (2) A sharp 'Ding' sound effect occurs as the speaker introduces the brand. Vocal delivery becomes more rhythmic, matching the background music's tempo. Music continues with bright synth pads and a consistent upbeat electronic rhythm. (3) A 'Pop' bubble sound effect marks a transition to the product demonstration. The speaker's tone shifts to descriptive as she lists various lipstick shades. BGM swells slightly in volume but remains perfectly balanced under the clear vocal track. (4) Distinct 'slurping' and 'chewing' foley sound effects are synchronized with the visual eating and drinking. The speaker makes a deliberate 'mwah' kissing sound. The music persists as a high-energy bed through these interactions. (5) Final bright 'Ding' sound effect. The speaker's emotional arousal remains high as she delivers a concluding recommendation. The track concludes with a sharp hard cut on both the music and voice.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook/Introduction -> Color Showcase/Swatching -> Performance Test (Durability) -> Summary/Endorsement.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and review the new shades of Maybelline Superstay Vinyl Ink lip glaze by showcasing its color variety, high-shine finish, and long-lasting, transfer-proof properties through enthusiastic verbal endorsement and a series of everyday stress tests (eating, drinking, kissing).

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand, product demonstration, verbal recommendation ('必買的'), and display of brand logos/packaging.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished beauty review with social-media native editing, using bright colors and energetic pacing to appeal to a young audience.
